[SWS_EthSwt_91005] Definition of API function EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndica-
tion ⌈
Service Name
EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndication
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthSwt_EthRxFinishedIndication (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx
)
Service ID [hex]
0x24
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
CtrlIdx
Ethernet Controller index
Parameters (in)
BufIdx
Ethernet Rx Buffer index
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Frame successfully processed
E_NOT_OK: Frame processing failed
Description
Indication for a finished receive process for a specific Ethernet frame, which results in providing
the management information retrieved during EthSwt_EthRxProcessFrame().
Available via
EthSwt_Eth.h
